name: consent_script
label:
Read the following statement to the respondent.
CONSENT: Good morning or afternoon. My name is __. I work with Kabarak University and its partner institutions on a research study titled "Quantifying the Hidden Health Costs of Climate Change for Equitable Health System Adaptation in Eastern and Southern Africa". The study is carried out in selected communities in Kenya and Malawi.
PurposeThe study aims to identify health problems caused or made worse by droughts, floods and extreme heat; to measure the costs households face when a member falls ill, including medical bills, transport, caregiving, lost income and time, and coping measures such as borrowing or selling assets; and to assess how well health services are prepared to respond.
What taking part involves. I will ask you questions about your household, recent illnesses, the cost of treatment and how your household has coped. One adult will be asked some questions in private about stress and feelings. With your permission, I will also measure the upper arm of each child aged 6 to 59 months and check the feet for swelling. These checks are painless. The interview will take about 45 to 60 minutes.
Risks, benefits and confidentiality. There are no known risks apart from the time taken, and you may decline to answer any question. There is no payment for taking part, but the findings will help governments and partners plan better health services during droughts, floods and extreme heat. Your answers will be kept confidential, your name will not appear in any report, and the information will be stored securely and used only for this study.
Voluntary participation. Taking part is your choice. You may refuse or stop at any time, and this will not affect any service you or your household receive.
Contacts. For questions about the study, contact Dr. Michael Walekhwa, Dr. Harrison Mbori or Dr. Idah Githu on: +254-705-290520, +254-729-035308 and +254-703-702711. For questions about your rights as a participant, contact Ms. Sarah Malinda on +254-715 -634073 or Ms. Caroline Jebichii on +254-720-057542. The study has been approved by Kabarak University ISERC – 051-343234 and licensed by NACOSTI/P/26/4198513 for Kenya, and NHSRC, for Malawi].
Do you have any questions? Do you agree to take part in this interview?
